title: Qualifying Races — 2027 Race Lottery — Western States Endurance Run
claims: The WSER official qualifying-races page states that the events listed are official qualifiers for the 2027 Western States Endurance Run, and that the qualifying run must be run from Monday 3 November 2025 through Sunday 8 November 2026.
The 2027 lottery table lists 'South Downs Way 100M England 6 2026 30 hours' as an official qualifier.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接抓取并读取该页。表格列为 Run / Distance / State-Country / Month / Year / Time / Notes；South Downs 行的月份为 6、年份 2026、时限 30 hours。

claimVerification.note: 正文：'Events below are official qualifiers for the 2027 Western States Endurance Run. The 2027 qualifying run must be run from Monday November 3, 2025 through Sunday November 8, 2026.'
